info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Adjustment API
info.description: The Market Adjustment API allows authorized users to adjust parameters related to market making activities, enhancing the efficiency and competitiveness of wholesale trading. It enables the modification of crucial trading attributes, ensuring real-time synchronization with market conditions. Typically utilized by trading firms and financial institutions, this API supports activities such as revising pricing strategies and updating liquidity provision. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their trading operations, respond to market dynamics promptly, and optimize their overall trading performance.
